saved_evidence.description: The City's scope statement for the University at Lomas reconstruction sets out the roadway, drainage and utility study work required, then the design, bid document and construction phase services the project needs.

text_excerpts.1:
CITY OF ALBUQUERQUE 
DEPARTMENT OF MUNICIPAL DEVELOPMENT 
 
UNIVERSITY BOULEVARD AT LOMAS BOULEVARD RECONSTRUCTION 
 
Project Number: 724692 
 
 
SCOPE OF PROJECT 
 
This Project May Include But Is Not Limited to the Following: 
 
Study Phase Services 
− 
Roadway Evaluations 
o Background Data Collection/As-Built Review, pavement condition analysis 
− 
Drainage Evaluations 
o Hydraulic/Hydrologic Analyses 
o Review of site conditions  
− 
Traffic Analysis 
o Signal timing alteration, Traffic counting and modeling 
 
Design Phase Services 
− 
Roadway Design 
o Concrete intersection design, PROWAG Implementation, Median Design 
− 
Storm Drain Design 
o Storm Pipe Network Design, Surface Flow Conveyance 
− 
Traffic Design 
o Traffic Signal Upgrade, Corridor Timing Development, ITS inclusion 
− 
DRC Submittals 
− 
Public Meetings 
 
Federal Funding / Certifications 
− 
Environmental Investigations, Cultural Studies, Utility Certification, Railroad Certification, ROW 
Certification, Intelligent Transportation System Certification, knowledge of federal procedures 
and processes (may be a part of this project, knowledge of this should be demonstrated). 
 
Bidding and Construction Phase Services 
− 
Compilation of contract documents for bidding of project 
− 
Work with contractor and City to execute contracts in timely manner 
− 
RFI Review and Record Drawing Compilation
text_excerpts.2:
STANDARD GUIDELINES 
 
− 
City of Albuquerque Development Process Manual 
− 
City of Albuquerque Specifications and Standard Drawings 
− 
City of Albuquerque Complete Streets Ordinance 
− 
Public Right of Way Accessibility Guidelines (PROWAG) 
− 
Manual on Uniform Traffic Control Devices (MUTCD) 
− 
American Association of State Highway and Transportation (AASHTO) 
− 
National Association of City Transportation Officials (NACTO) 
− 
Highway Capacity Manual (HCM) 
 
 
EXPECTATIONS 
 
For Contract 
 
− 
Good communication with City reps 
− 
Project Coordination 
− 
Knowledge of Federal Funding Reimbursement Requirements (if applicable) 
− 
Progress Billings 
 
For Proposal 
− 
Detailed Team Member Experience 
− 
Detailed Firm City Related Experience 
− 
Follow advertisement guidelines exactly 
− 
Proposals Due Thursday, August 27th, 2020 by 3 PM. Please note that the City of Albuquerque is 
open for business and will be accepting proposals electronically. Send your proposals to 
myrnamarquez@cabq.gov by the deadline noted. For now, a copy of your general and 
professional liability insurance coverage is acceptable in lieu of the notary stamp. In order to 
assure your proposal is delivered, make sure it is 5MB or less and is in PDF format. Thank you 
and stay safe!
